shots.focal_element: Woman in a burgundy blazer walking down the aisle of an open-plan office, framed on the right third
shots.what_happens: Wide, letterboxed live-action shot: the protagonist walks toward camera through a bright office of green-partitioned desks while saying 'Jim is that way' (w202-w205); a colleague at a desk in the left foreground looks on. A chime is detected near the end of the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Film a static wide shot down a central office aisle with a deep vanishing point, letterbox to roughly 2.39:1, and have the lead walk toward camera on the right third while the line plays.

shots.focal_element: Motion-blurred black loafers striding across a grey carpet
shots.what_happens: Floor-level insert of the protagonist's feet walking left to right past red and teal office furniture, heavy motion blur; starts a rapid no-dialogue montage (no words between w205 and w206).
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 0.6 s floor-level tracking shot of feet mid-stride with a slow shutter for motion blur, hard-cut on the beat to open a montage.

shots.focal_element: Hand pressing the chrome lever or button on top of an espresso machine
shots.what_happens: Macro product-style insert: a blurred hand in the foreground presses a control on a chrome espresso machine, shallow depth of field; a click-like SFX is detected just after the shot ends.
shots.build_rebuild: Shoot a 0.4 s macro insert of a fingertip pressing a chrome machine control with shallow focus, and sync a click SFX to the press.

shots.focal_element: Stream of espresso pouring from a chrome spout into a ribbed brown cup
shots.what_happens: Warm-lit macro of espresso pouring into a ribbed cup, with ornate chrome machine parts on the right and a soft, blurred background; one beat of the coffee montage.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a 0.5 s warm-graded macro of the espresso pour, cup on the left third and machine chrome on the right, shot at a shallow aperture.

shots.focal_element: Coffee cup, seen in the contact sheet as the protagonist sipping and in the keyframe as a top-down hand holding an espresso cup
shots.what_happens: A very short 0.17 s flash beat of the coffee montage. The keyframe shows a top-down hand gripping a white espresso cup on a grey surface with a soft drop shadow; the contact sheet frame (1:16.500) shows the woman drinking from the ribbed cup while looking up. Both may fall inside this cut.
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 4-frame flash of a top-down espresso cup held on a plain grey surface to keep the montage pacing staccato.

shots.focal_element: Protagonist downing coffee while looking upward, then a finger pressing a lit elevator up button
shots.transition_other: Detector flagged a non-hard-cut boundary inside a rapid flash montage; the exact transition cannot be seen at 2 fps.
shots.what_happens: The keyframe shows a high-angle close-up of the woman draining the ribbed cup while staring up, with a vignette. The contact sheet frame at 1:17.000 shows a finger pressing an illuminated elevator up-arrow button. The montage moves from coffee to the elevator as she heads off to tell Jim.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut a 0.6 s high-angle close-up of the lead gulping coffee straight into a tight insert of a finger pressing a backlit elevator up button, with each beat timed to the music.
